svg.title: Projects: Koda: A voice-first AI pair programmer — talk to it; it does the engineering.; Grove: Human-curated agentic memory — a locator, not an injector.; Noesis: Persistent intelligence layer for AI coding agents.; OpenVille: Autonomous Multi-Agent Tradespeople Marketplace & Negotiation Engine

text.tspan: A voice-first AI pair programmer — talk to it; it does the engineering.

g.text: Built a two-tier voice agent behind a LiveKit audio room, running 24/7 on a VPS with the phone as
Autonomously navigates codebases, manages version control, and delegates to coding tools,
Steerable by design: high-autonomy execution that stays conversational and under the user's

text.tspan: Human-curated agentic memory — a locator, not an injector.

g.text: Designed a memory model of plain-folder "context trees" curated entirely by the user, with
nothing auto-remembered or injected behind their back
Built an engine that locates the right tree on return and reads it in full, resuming a session as
if the abandoned one never ended
Inverts mainstream agentic memory: the machine never quietly remembers or forgets anything

text.tspan: Persistent intelligence layer for AI coding agents.

g.text: Fused memory, workflow, and auto-integration into a single layer spanning 9 CLI coding tools
Engineered SQLite-backed memory with hybrid retrieval, a knowledge graph, and HMAC integrity
Shipped distribution adapters for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Aider, Codex CLI, and more

text.tspan: Autonomous Multi-Agent Tradespeople Marketplace & Negotiation Engine

g.text: Built a semantic RAG engine using vector embeddings and cosine similarity for high-accuracy
Implemented weighted multi-factor ranking with real-time preference adjustments and cost/quality
Designed a multi-stage pipeline handling reasoning, real-time agent negotiation, and transaction
